hook.line: Google gave you 10 blue links; AI collapses search into one recommendation.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up of a bearded man at his office desk, finger raised, white-box title 'SEO is slowly dying' on top and a 2-word red-highlight caption below his chin.

beats.what: Contrast opener: Google's 10 blue links versus ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, with the 'SEO is slowly dying' title pinned on top
AI collapses search into one or a few recommendations
Stakes: usually one winner, one business gets the slot
The fix: intentionally structure content so AI engines cite and trust you
Names the idea: this is AEO, SEO is not dead, it is SEO 2.0
Fear beat: competitors will take every opportunity to crush you
Urgency: get ahead before everyone shifts to AI answers; he leans closer to the lens
Offer: DM the word AEO for a free audit
Soft upsell close: maybe you want us to do it for you

why_it_works: Old-versus-new contrast in the first sentence (10 blue links vs one AI answer) gives the viewer an instant mental picture of the change
Scarcity framing ('one winner') turns an abstract trend into a personal loss the viewer wants to avoid
Keyword DM offer ('DM me AEO') is a low-effort action that also feeds comments and DMs to the algorithm
Active word highlighted in red in the 2-3 word captions keeps eyes moving during a single 75 s take with zero cuts
weaknesses: One unbroken 75 s shot with no cuts, punches or visuals; retention relies only on his voice and hand gestures
Never shows what an AI answer citing a business looks like, so the claim stays abstract
The CTA arrives at 62 s, after most viewers have likely left
Captions sit low and mostly outside the safe area, where the TikTok UI covers them
for_robert: Steal the one-sentence old-vs-new contrast opener (10 blue links vs one AI answer) and let Fred physically shrink a list of links into a single card; avoid his 75 s no-cut take.
